props.name: Notched Tide Stake
props.prompt: A crooked knee-high driftwood stake with three deep tide notches and a ragged kelp tie; its lowest cut is freshly submerged.

props.name: Kelp-Woven Watch Blind
props.prompt: A tall narrow screen of wet kelp woven over crooked poles, with a slit at eye height and one side sagging toward the mud.

props.name: Eel-Drying Rack
props.prompt: A waist-high forked rack of salt-black timber, hung with a few limp eel skins and scraps of net; no catch looks fresh.

props.name: Woven Eel Creel
props.prompt: A squat reed creel with a swollen, algae-stained base and its lid tied shut with fishing gut.

props.name: Tarred Smuggler Skiff
props.prompt: A narrow low-sided skiff daubed in tar, dragged onto the mud; a patched canvas hood hides its empty middle.

props.name: Flood-Sealed Cargo Crate
props.prompt: A squat timber crate with swollen seams sealed in tar and rust-red straps, scuffed by repeated dragging over stone.

props.name: Weighted Net Bundle
props.prompt: A heavy, knotted fishing net bundled around smooth lead weights; strands trail a little water and cling with algae.

props.name: Driftwood Cairn
props.prompt: A low cairn of salt-bleached driftwood branches and flat stones, wedged together against the wind and tide.

props.name: Hooded Mooring Lantern
props.prompt: A squat iron lantern fixed to a short ground spike, its shuttered panes barely holding a sickly blue-green flame.

props.name: Half-Buried Stone Marker
props.prompt: A broad, waist-high slab of dark stone, tilted in the mud and scored with concentric grooves nearly erased by lichen.

props.name: Warm Luminous Tide Pool
props.prompt: A shallow, still pool in a natural depression; dim green light seeps from below, outlining dead fish at its edge.

props.name: Kelp-Bound Offering Slab
props.prompt: A low flat slab of slate wrapped in rotting kelp cords, its surface scored by careful parallel cuts and washed clean by the tide.

props.name: Collapsed Fissure Mouth
props.prompt: A jagged natural cleft between two leaning slabs, partly screened by dripping kelp; a narrow stair of worn stone descends into darkness.

props.name: Grooved Bell-Path Stone
props.prompt: A half-submerged circular stone ring, only a section exposed; its smooth grooves catch faint harbor-glow, with no lettering or ornament.

surfaces.name: Algae-Slicked Mud
surfaces.prompt: Soft tidal mud, slick with dark algae and shallow reflective puddles; faint blue-green pinpricks glow beneath the surface.

surfaces.name: Damp Sand
surfaces.prompt: Low sandbars of compact damp sand, scored by receding water and strewn with thin smears of algae.

surfaces.name: Tide-Worn Track
surfaces.prompt: A narrow winding track of packed sand, driftwood slats and crushed shells, vanishing under the fog at each bend.

blueprint.summary: A broken chain of muddy islands and sandbars links Haven to the outer settlements, with winding tide-tracks between glowing channels. Keeper lookouts and a clandestine landing flank a half-buried stone way toward the temple; a fissure at the far end descends into the Kelp Caves.

areas.name: Havenward Mudflat
areas.purpose: The broad, treacherous approach from Haven. Tide stakes mark the least-sinking route, though several now stand underwater; the track forks toward the outposts and the deeper channels.

areas.name: Outpost of the Kelp Keepers
areas.purpose: A low island where wary fishers watch the channels and mark the sick tide. It offers shelter only from rain, not from the fog or whatever moves within it.

areas.name: The Guild's Black Landing
areas.purpose: A concealed landing used to shift forbidden cargo between skiffs and hidden coves. Drag marks lead away from it, but none return from the waterward side.

areas.name: The Sick Tide Pools
areas.purpose: Warm pools gleam among the flats, ringed by dead fish and slick tracks. Stillness here makes the low seabed hum easier to hear.

areas.name: The Last Nets
areas.purpose: A small Kelp Keeper camp on a sand hump, abandoned in haste: tools remain laid out, and the cooking place is cold beneath a mantle of mist.

areas.name: The Old Chart Way
areas.purpose: A narrow exposed shelf of stone and packed sand follows the route shown on old charts. A grooved ring of stone appears at low water, then vanishes beneath the rising tide.

areas.name: The Kelp-Wrapped Flat
areas.purpose: A screened patch of mud where desperate recruits are brought under cover of fog. The slab is clean of footprints except for a narrow trail leading back toward the landing.

areas.name: The Drowned Fissure
areas.purpose: A tide-worn cleft opens below the outer flats, its stone steps descending toward the Kelp Caves. The entrance is passable only in the briefest slack water.
